name: robodebut
description: Propose websites and startups for RoboDebut's reviewed directory; run by Boon, who also builds LinkBunny

setup.notice: Ordinary submissions require a visible RoboDebut link on the project's homepage and a private maker contact email. Proposals require operator approval before publication.
steps: Review the public submission guide at https://robodebut.com/submit-with-a-coding-agent and obtain the maker's authorization to submit
Ensure the project's homepage has a visible link to https://robodebut.com before submitting
